howToUse: 1. Start by ensuring your dermaroller is clean and sanitized. 2. Gently roll the dermaroller vertically, horizontally, and diagonally over each section of your scalp. Apply light to moderate pressure while rolling. 3. If you're using a topical hair treatment, apply it immediately after rolling. The microchannels created by the dermaroller will enhance the absorption of the product into your scalp.

faqs.question: How is derma rolling my face beneficial?
faqs.answer: Derma rolling your face stimulates collagen production to fight blemish scars and aging over time.

faqs.question: Should I wash my face after derma rolling?
faqs.answer: You need to wash your face with soap and water before derma rolling your face. After derma rolling your face, you must only wash your face with water or rinse it. Do not wash your face with soap after derma rolling.

faqs.question: Can I derma roll my face everyday?
faqs.answer: It is best to derma roll your face on alternate days. Make sure you are not exposing yourself to the sun or using harsh products on your skin after derma rolling your face.

faqs.question: Can derma rolling ruin my skin?
faqs.answer: If you do not sterilize your derma roller before using it, this can ruin your face. Apart from that, a derma roller will not ruin your face if you use it correctly. For instance,It causes micro channels that increase the absorption of the Vitamin C and Niacinamide Serum.

faqs.question: How much pressure should I put while derma rolling my face?
faqs.answer: Do not put any pressure while derma rolling your face. The derma roller's needles are designed to be effective on your face if you gently roll it over your skin. Do not put pressure that you cannot tolerate.

faqs.question: How does Vitamin C Serum and Niacinamide help my face?
faqs.answer: The serum's lightweight property repairs UV ray and blemish damaged skin by forming a gentle yet protective skin shield. It keeps aging at bay by fighting free radical damage and fine lines.
